messages:
anya: Quick check-in — planning a 6-week PLG funnel experiment tied to the upcoming webinar + benchmark blog. Goal: lift first-week activation (trial -> active) by 20% using free credits + onboarding nudges. Thoughts?
sam: love it. can we A/B test credit sizes? maybe $50 vs $150 equivalent in tokens. keep one arm with a small credit + targeted prompt templates.
luke: Agree on credit sizing. Also want a control group with no credits but extra onboarding emails. We should measure: activation rate (first 48h), 7‑day retention, avg tokens first 7 days.
maria: I'll own webinar landing page + registration flow. Let's route registrants to an inbound funnel: auto-create leads in SF when usage > 1k tokens in 24h OR if they request a demo. For small teams route to SDR queue; for enterprise (company email domain) route to AE.
anya: perfect. can we get a lightweight webhook spec for the router? ops-bot: Deploy note — new webhook endpoint /hooks/lead-route created, expects payload: `\{"email\":\"...\",\"company\":\"...\",\"tokens_used\":1234,\"signed_up_at\":\"...\"}`. will add to docs.
sam: Messaging for launch posts — draft variants: 
- Variant A (benchmark narrative): “Redwood Inference: run open LLMs with predictable latency and 2–5x lower per‑token costs — new benchmark + config guide.”
- Variant B (PLG hook): “Try Redwood free — $150 in credits, built-in prompt templates to get you to production faster. Webinar: how we cut inference costs.”
luke: Short social copy for Twitter/LinkedIn: “Built for production LLMs — predictable latency + cost controls. Join our webinar and grab free credits: <link>” Keep it under 200 chars.
maria: Webinar plan checklist: 1) 20‑minute demo (console + templates) 2) 20‑minute best practices (benchmarking + cost controls) 3) 10‑minute Q&A + live routing promo 4) CTA + one-click free credits. Need speakers: anya (product), luke (runtime), sam (growth).
anya: Speaker notes: emphasize how prompt templates + caching reduced token usage for a sample app. show before/after cost per 1k requests.
sam: Email subject test ideas: 
- A: "You’re invited: Cut LLM inference costs — webinar + $150 credit"
- B: "Free credits inside — learn how to run LLMs reliably at scale"
- C: "Benchmark + quickstart: Redwood Inference webinar"
luke: For onboarding nudges, propose in-app flows: 
1) Immediate: 3 templated prompts surfaced in dashboard (chat, summarize, classify)
2) 6‑hr email: "Try these prompts to see response patterns"
3) 24‑hr push: token usage reward (extra $25 credit if >2k tokens used).
maria: We should instrument cohort analysis by signup_source (webinar, blog, organic). Add UTM tag on webinar reg link: `?utm_source=webinar_apr2024&utm_campaign=end_of_q2`
anya: Quick experiment matrix I sketched: 
- Arm 1: $150 credit + templates + nudges (expected uplift)
- Arm 2: $50 credit + templates + nudges
- Arm 3: No credit + aggressive onboarding emails
- Control: baseline onboarding
Measure: activation@48h, conversion@30d, avg token spend@7d.
sam: Who will own analytics? @luke? Need a shared sheet and looker dashboard. Also we should create a simple funnel email copy for each arm.
luke: I’ll spin up dashboards. Create sheet: https://app.example.com/sheets/plg-webinar-experiment (placeholder). I’ll add the segments and SQL for activation event: `events where name='first_active' and props.tokens > 0`
maria: Routing decision rules (first pass): 
- enterprise domain (company size >250) OR manu sales opt-in -> AE queue
- tokens_used > 5k within 3 days -> SDR+AE alert (hot lead)
- otherwise -> self-serve drip + weekly tips series
anya: Also add a benchmark narrative paragraph for the blog: highlight 3 workloads (chat, summarization, embeddings) with latency and cost table; call out how batching + KV caching yields X% lower cost vs naive hosting. Keep it technical but accessible.
sam: CTA in blog: "Get $150 free credits and production templates — sign up". Link to webinar and one-click credits.
luke: Ops note: ensure quota guardrails for free credits to prevent abuse. Set initial cap: $300 max per org lifetime for this experiment.
maria: Timeline: 
- This week: finalize copy + registration page
- Next week: run A/B ads + send save-the-date
- Two weeks: webinar + email blast + cohort routing live
- Post-webinar: 7-day activation analysis
anya: Can someone volunteer to draft the short benchmark blurb? 3 paragraphs + 1 table.
sam: I can draft. will post by EOD Friday.
luke: I'll validate numbers and add charts.
anya: ok team — tagging owners: sam (copy + launch posts), maria (landing + routing), luke (analytics + infra), me (experiment design + blog). We’ll sync Thurs 10am to finalize. :thumbsup:
maria: added calendar event. ops-bot: New automation created: `lead_routing_v1` enabled in staging. Monitor logs at /ops/lead-route/logs.
anya: awesome — thanks all.
